name: Commercial Business Case Formulation
purpose: Formulate commercial business cases, quantify return on investment (ROI), articulate differentiated value propositions, model monetization options, and anticipate buyer objections for Sales, Commercial, and Finance Analysts.
whenToUse: Evaluating commercial viability and investment justification during Gate G0 and G1
Developing pricing models, monetization strategies, and unit economics estimates
Constructing enterprise objection-handling playbooks and go-to-market battlecards
Quantifying customer total cost of ownership (TCO) and projected financial return
prerequisites: Project Mission Statement or draft Project Contract (contracts/project/contract.json)
Target customer profiles and preliminary product capabilities
Market pricing data or competitor benchmarking information

inputs.name: projectContract
inputs.description: Approved or draft Project Contract specifying scope and strategic objectives

inputs.name: targetAudienceData
inputs.description: Buyer personas, economic decision maker roles, and target market segments

inputs.name: costAndRevenueParameters
inputs.description: Estimated engineering costs, operational expenses, and target pricing models

procedure.title: Target Audience & Buyer Persona Profiling
procedure.action: Profile the economic buyer, technical evaluation lead, and end-user personas with their respective pain points and success metrics.

procedure.title: Value Proposition Canvas Mapping
procedure.action: Map proposed product features to direct customer gains and pain relievers to establish differentiated value pillars.

procedure.title: Customer Objection Anticipation & Defense Playbook
procedure.action: Systematically catalog anticipated objections across security, pricing, migration cost, and vendor risk, pairing each with evidence-backed rebuttals.

procedure.title: Quantitative ROI & TCO Financial Modeling
procedure.action: Construct a financial model showing customer cost baseline, savings from solution adoption, payback period, and 3-year ROI.

procedure.title: Pricing & Monetization Strategy Formulation
procedure.action: Model recommended pricing structures (per-seat, usage-based, tiered) and align them with customer value realization.

procedure.title: Commercial Risk Assessment & Go-to-Market Brief Synthesis
procedure.action: Compile commercial risks, regulatory constraints, and sales cycle friction into an executive Commercial Business Case.

expectedOutputs: Comprehensive Commercial Business Case and Financial ROI Model
Value Proposition Matrix and Customer Messaging Framework
Enterprise Objection Handling Playbook and Risk Register

potentialFailures: Unsubstantiated ROI figures based on speculative efficiency gains
Ignoring enterprise procurement objections (security, compliance, data lock-in)
Pricing models misaligned with customer budget and value consumption
failureAndRecovery.recoveryStrategy: Require transparent formulas with conservative baseline parameters. Solicit input from security and legal stakeholders to address compliance objections. Benchmark pricing against established market alternatives.

verificationCriteria: ROI calculations include explicit formulas and stated assumptions
Every listed customer objection includes a concrete, factual rebuttal strategy
Target buyer personas clearly identify the economic decision-maker with budget authority
